products.name: Do Not Bow
products.author: Dr Michaels Aibangbee
products.summary: Three young men on the plain of Dura, and the faith that would not bow.
products.description: Do Not Bow returns to the plain of Dura, where three young Hebrew men stood firm while an empire bowed. It traces a six-stage progression of compromise, names the cultural pressures that quietly pull believers away from wholehearted devotion to God, and calls readers to a “But if not” faith: loyalty to God even if deliverance never comes. The book launches on Sunday 15 November, the last day of RAIN 2026.

images.alt: The front cover of Do Not Bow: The Cascade of Compromise, by Dr Michaels Aibangbee, PhD, with a foreword by Ps Osas Michaels-Aibangbee. The title stands in tall letters over a city street at night, where one young man stands while the crowd around him kneels beneath billboards for success, power and money.
The back cover of Do Not Bow: the description of the book, a short biography and photograph of the author, and the Ark House Press imprint with the ISBN, 978-1-7647507-9-0.
